findings.title: The page's first large image is lazy, late or oversized
findings.evidence: The first large image, https://quillfeather.example/img/loaves.jpg?w=3840, is lazy-loaded, so the browser waits to fetch it; and is asked for at 3840 pixels wide but shown 800 wide: it is probably what the page's largest paint waits for.

findings.title: A 3D scene starts as soon as the page loads
findings.evidence: A 3D scene starts as soon as the page loads: three.min.js is loaded and the page has a canvas, and no "click to start" or "tap to enter" step was found, so every visitor pays for it before any input.

findings.title: A heavy page has no Save-Data or low-end-device fallback
findings.evidence: The page loads a 3D scene and nothing in its own scripts or styles reads the visitor's data saver (Save-Data), device memory, core count or connection type, so a small phone on a slow connection gets the same heavy load as a desktop. Scripts from other sites are not read.
